title: PhysxVehicleControllerAPI
summary: Driver inputs (throttle, brakes, steer, target gear) of a vehicle that has a drive. The runtime checks that the vehicle prim lists it and reads its columns once, when the vehicle is created; PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI adds thrust inputs on top.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:accelerator
columns.absent: 0: no throttle. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:brake0
columns.absent: 0: braking system brakes0 released. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only when the vehicle has PhysxVehicleBrakesAPI braking systems; brake0 commands the brakes0 instance. Without them it is still read and range-checked but not applied.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:brake1
columns.absent: 0: braking system brakes1 released. A present value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only when the vehicle has PhysxVehicleBrakesAPI braking systems; brake1 commands the brakes1 instance. Without them it is still read and range-checked but not applied.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:brake
columns.absent: 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only with the deprecated brakes setup (no PhysxVehicleBrakesAPI on the vehicle), as the command of braking system 0.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:handbrake
columns.absent: 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only with the deprecated brakes setup (no PhysxVehicleBrakesAPI on the vehicle), as the command of braking system 1.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:steer
columns.absent: 0: no steer. A present value outside [-1, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only when the vehicle has PhysxVehicleSteeringAPI or PhysxVehicleAckermannSteeringAPI; without either the deprecated steerLeft and steerRight are applied instead.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:steerLeft
columns.absent: 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only without a steering API (deprecated steer setup); the steer command is then steerLeft - steerRight.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:steerRight
columns.absent: 0. Deprecated and read only when authored (every present ovstage column counts as authored): a nonzero value logs a deprecation warning, and a value outside [0, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: Applied only without a steering API (deprecated steer setup); the steer command is then steerLeft - steerRight.

columns.name: physxVehicleController:targetGear
columns.absent: 255: automatic forward gear shifting. A present value other than 255 must lie in [-1, 30] (reverse, neutral, forward gears), otherwise an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
columns.notes: The upper bound is 30, the vehicle gearbox's maximum gear count minus 2. The schema expects PhysxVehicleAutoGearBoxAPI on the drive for automatic shifting.

interactions.rule: Read only on a prim that lists PhysxVehicleAPI, after the vehicle passed its other validation. The vehicle must have a drive (physxVehicle:drive, or a drive API on the vehicle prim); otherwise an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
Mutually exclusive: when a wheel attachment of the vehicle lists PhysxVehicleWheelControllerAPI, an error is logged and the vehicle is not created.
When that API is listed too, these columns are read on the tank controller path, which adds physxVehicleTankController:thrust0 and thrust1.

notes: Every column is change-tracked: the runtime applies a new value while simulating; an out-of-range value then logs an error and is ignored instead of invalidating the vehicle.
On reset the runtime writes the initial controller values back through the data-write sink; an attach without a sink skips that.
